1. The target VM #2 runs Grafana on port 3000. The service is vulnerable to CVE-2021-43798, which is a directory traversal vulnerability. Search for "golangexample cve-2021-43798" in a search engine to get familiar with how the vulnerability can be exploited. Use curl and the --path-as-is parameter to find the flag in C:\Users\install.txt.
